mainEntity.name: When will I see new hair growth?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most patients see reduced shedding after the second or third session and visible density improvement at 3 to 6 months. PRP works on the hair growth cycle and results are gradual. Photographic comparison is the best way to track change — we document scalp at baseline and every visit.

We draw a small volume of blood from your arm and centrifuge it in-office to separate the platelet-rich plasma. The PRP is then injected at intervals into the scalp using a fine needle. The full session, including blood draw and centrifugation, takes about 60–90 minutes.

We apply topical anaesthetic to the scalp before injection and the discomfort is generally manageable. A scalp vibration device can also be used to further reduce sensation. Most patients describe the procedure as tolerable and resume activity the same day.

hero.title: Hair Restoration + PRP in Miami
hero.lede: Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP) prepared from your own blood and injected into the scalp to stimulate follicular activity, slow thinning, and improve hair density in androgenic alopecia.

blocks.title: What it does for you
list: Stimulates dormant hair follicles through concentrated growth factors from your own platelets.
Slows the progression of androgenic alopecia (male- and female-pattern thinning).
Improves hair density, thickness, and overall scalp health.
100% autologous — uses only the patient's own plasma, no synthetic compounds.
Initial protocol typically 3–4 sessions spaced 4 weeks apart, then maintenance every 4–6 months.
Pairs well with topical minoxidil or oral finasteride for compounded effect.
